system.description:
The quickest way to get anywhere by air, provided the route is a straight line.

Super Stalin. Must keep moving or start to fall: it needs Momentum 5 to take off and must cover at least 100 x base Speed meters per round to stay up.

Flying Crowbar. Cannot turn during an ordinary Move action.
system.effect: The quickest way to get anywhere by air, provided the route is a straight line.
